Noor A: Hey folks 914 quick benefits/payroll q after my first week: I'm auto-enrolled in the 401k but want to confirm match details, vesting schedule, and whether contributions are prorated if you start mid-pay-period (I started 2025-06-10). Also trying to choose between HSA vs Health FSA 6b8 9fe any guidance? Lastly, do company holidays get pro-rated for new hires or do we get the full allotment?

Jules (People Ops): Welcome Noor! :wave: Short answers: 401k match = company matches 100% of the first 3% deferred then 50% of the next 2% (so max 4% total). Vesting is on a 3-year graded schedule (33% after year 1, 66% after year 2, fully vested after year 3). Contributions are taken each pay period; if you started mid-pay-period your first paycheck will reflect only the pay and deductions for the days worked in that period (prorated).

Noor A: Thanks. How do I change my deferral % and where do I see the match posting?

Benefits Admin: Change deferral in the 401k vendor portal (link in Workday > Benefits > Retirement). Match posts each quarter to your 401k account and you'll see a company contribution line in the vendor statement. If you want us to walk through the portal, DM and we can do a screenshare.

Payroll Bot: Payroll notes: Redwood runs biweekly payroll on Fridays. For a mid-period start the gross/withholdings are proportional to days/hours. Employer 401k match is an after-pay-period posting by Finance (quarterly), not a per-pay-period line item.

Noor A: HSA vs FSA practical differences? I have a high-deductible plan.

Benefits Admin: If you have a qualifying HDHP, HSA is generally better long-term: funds roll over year-to-year, employer contributions (if any) and your pre-tax contributions grow tax-free, and it's portable. FSA is use-it-or-lose-it (some limited carryover). For 2025 HSA max employee+employer = $4,600 (family), FSA health limit = $3,050. Also check if Redwood contributes to HSA (some teams get a small employer seed).

Noor A: Does enrollment into HSA lock me for the year?

Jules (People Ops): You can only change elections mid-year with a qualifying life event. Open enrollment next November otherwise.

Noor A: About holidays 384 are new hires entitled to the full set of holidays immediately?

Sam F: Holidays: Redwood publishes 10 company holidays + 1 floating. For payroll, non-exempt employees get paid holidays if employed on the holiday date. We don't prorate the holiday count but if your start date is after a holiday you won't retroactively get it. For exempt staff, holiday pay is handled per policy in Workday > Time Off tab.

Noor A: One last thing 4dd I submitted an expense for desk lamp/reimb last Tue under "newhire-setup" in Expensify. Any ETA?

Jules (People Ops): Reimbursements are reviewed within 3 business days by People Ops, then Finance issues payment on the next AP run (Tues/Thu). If amount > $500 we need manager approval which can add a day. If you paste the Expensify link/ID here we'll flag it.

Noor A: Cool thanks! Appreciate the clarity :clap:
